A slip: a printed strip showing the whole card face except the art, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-deathstardetentionblockcontrolroom-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Death Star: Detention Block Control Room]] (Decipher, December 1995): The game text changes: “Light Side:” is dropped; “captured” becomes “imprisoned”. This is a slip: the whole card face except the art set again with this text, with a black strip below with the title “•Death Star: Detention Block Control Room” and a white italic “E”.

The printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
